paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: This figure compares the error rate (one average minus test accuracy), computation cost, and GPU memory across our approach and baselines, for fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks with QAdapter.

model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage in gigabytes (GB) for various fine-tuning methods, including Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, Adapter, QAdapter, and Ours. The horizontal axis lists these methods in a specific order, while the vertical axis is labeled "GPU Memory (GB)" and ranges from 0 to 60 GB with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20 GB. Each method is represented by a bar, with the height corresponding to its GPU memory usage; the bars for Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, Adapter, and QAdapter are orange, while the bar for Ours is green. The GPU memory usage values are approximately 73 GB for Full FT, 40 GB for MTL-FT, 15 GB for TAG, 12 GB for Adapter, 6 GB for QAdapter, and 13 GB for Ours. The bars are not sorted in any particular numerical order, and the green bar for Ours is visually distinct from the other orange bars.
